# Agent Doctor

> Offline MCP tool-schema audits, version comparisons, and repository diagnostics.

## Start here

- [Browser workbench](https://nnoppons.github.io/agent-doctor/): open or paste a JSON tool export, compare a second version, and export Markdown or JSON. Input stays in the browser. The browser uses the TypeScript analyzer and reports heuristic context sizes, not exact token usage or compatibility.
- [Native Rust commands](https://github.com/NnopponS/agent-doctor/tree/main/rust): audit or compare local tool catalogs. The optional CI gate tests selected breaking changes and exits 2 when it detects one. It does not run tools or prove compatibility for every JSON Schema.
- [Node.js CLI and Actions](https://github.com/NnopponS/agent-doctor#quickstart-from-source): static schema and repository auditing, SARIF, and a legacy local stdio inspector. Only run trusted processes in live mode.
